description: Restart a hosted app's container. Use when an app is wedged, or to apply changed environment variables.
name: vibekit_restart_app

outputSchema.description: Result envelope: ok=true with data on success, ok=false with error on failure.

data.description: Restart confirmation and resulting container status.

error.description: Error message when ok is false (e.g. missing/invalid VIBEKIT_API_KEY, or an API error).

title: VibeKit Restart App
